canonical_findings.evidence: Project relocation can change canonical_root while a nonterminal Run retains only an old path/revision, and explicit execution_root has no independent filesystem identity or physical-effect recheck.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Immutable Session binding is not paired with a versioned WorkspaceResolution record and a Run-admission/effect/relocation concurrency fence.

canonical_findings.evidence: The private run_id-to-authority getter exists and its contextvar/MCP wiring spike passed 3 tests, but built-ins can still call _execution_context and recover the global root; the 77-tool catalog has no exhaustive projectless admission field.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Missing ToolContext metadata is still ambiguous between legacy-unknown and explicit projectless, and not every wrapper is forced through the durable private Run authority.

canonical_findings.evidence: The macOS symlink and same-volume rename spike passed, but no Windows result exists and explicit execution roots need the same identity oracle.
canonical_findings.root_cause: The supported filesystem identity boundary and executable Windows oracle are not frozen as a release gate.

canonical_findings.evidence: Current creation allocates UUID in memory and commits Session, owner, route and Provider inheritance separately; no durable request receipt makes lost-ACK replay stable.
canonical_findings.root_cause: There is no request-keyed creation state transition under the existing provider-registry-to-SessionDB lock order.

canonical_findings.evidence: Delete currently tombstones delivery/owner but retains Session; ensure_session can clear the delivery tombstone while owner reactivation is forbidden, and the proposed binding trigger defines neither retention nor replay.
canonical_findings.root_cause: ACTIVE and DELETED are not canonical terminal states spanning delivery, owner, route, Provider, Project binding and idempotency receipt.

canonical_findings.evidence: The current list applies message-backed and product-history filters after repository lookup; an unbounded 100k response measured about 19.3 MB and the current plan defines no catalog revision, keyset cursor, pinned selection, payload or mounted-row bounds.
canonical_findings.root_cause: The target changes both visibility authority and cardinality without a query-time active/product predicate and bounded hierarchical protocol.

canonical_findings.evidence: The old lazy-schema prerequisite is stale because v17-v31 are migration-owned, but a post-v32 application backfill would run outside initialize_state_db backup/restore with no phase, cursor or completion digest.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Schema installation and semantic legacy conversion have separate startup owners and no durable upgrade state machine or backup lifetime spanning both.

decisions.rationale: Add WorkspaceResolutionV1/v3 authority persistence, explicit-root identity, Project revision CAS, nonterminal-Run relocation rejection and two physical identity checks.
Force built-in and MCP wrappers through the private run_id authority getter and make projectless admission a total fail-closed manifest field; the seam feasibility spike already passed.
Freeze an executable cross-platform probe/oracle and keep Windows proof as a mandatory plan-task stop gate; macOS evidence is already recorded.
Add durable request receipts and one provider-lock then SessionDB transaction whose commit is the only visibility point.
Define ACTIVE/DELETED lifecycle, retain immutable binding/receipt provenance, forbid Session ID revival and make delete replay idempotent.
Replace the nested unbounded response with revisioned Project and per-scope Session keyset pages, pinned selection, hard payload and DOM bounds.
Correct the stale architecture fact and add a startup-blocking resumable backfill ledger plus verified backup/restore boundary and crash matrix.

conflicts.resolution: Primary evidence treated the version-contract issue as current; specialist code/test evidence shows v17-v31 ownership is already closed. Preserve only the still-open post-v32 backfill recovery defect and correct the architecture fact.

plan_actions: Revise target schema and Task 2 with session_creation_receipts and terminal lifecycle.
Revise Task 3 to a hierarchical revisioned keyset protocol with active/product SQL predicate and hard budgets.
Revise Task 4 with WorkspaceResolutionV1, private authority getter, tool admission inventory and relocation/effect fences.
Revise Tasks 1 and 9 with a checked-in cross-platform identity probe and Windows stop gate.
Revise Task 8 with a startup-blocking ProjectSessionUpgradeCoordinator, verified backup manifest, chunk cursor and restore command.
Link recorded macOS, performance and private authority wiring spike results from the plan.
